# Macrion 0.1.0

This is the first public Macrion release. Macrion begins as an independent Android automation app derived from Klick'r, with its own app identity and release path.

## Highlights

- Create image-aware and regular click/swipe automations.
- Trigger and control scenarios through external automation integrations.
- Include condition-performance details in Debug Reports.
- Import existing Klick'r backups and optionally export Klick'r-compatible backups.

Macrion is still an early release. Back up important scenarios before upgrading and report problems through the repository's issue tracker.

## Installation

Download the APK matching your device. `arm64-v8a` is the usual choice for modern Android phones; use the universal APK if you are unsure.

Because Macrion is distributed directly through GitHub, Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser or file manager. The app also needs Accessibility and screen-capture access for its core automation features.
